decided.resume_granularity: atomically committed band boundaries only; partial bands are discarded and recomputed; reservoir/accumulator state is transient and never persisted; a phase event alone never establishes resumability

artifact_schema.plan.json: binding run plan covering every identity field listed in the spec; plan_hash = sha256 over the canonical sorted-key serialization
artifact_schema.checkpoint.json: committed contiguous band prefix with per-band artifact name, byte size, sha256 and dense_overlap_count; checkpoint_hash over canonical serialization; rewritten atomically as the LAST step of each band commit
artifact_schema.band-%04d.bin: 64-byte self-describing header + record_count * 64-byte ForwardDrizzleV2PixelResult records, host byte order (trusted-run derived artifact)
artifact_schema.commit.json: written only after all bands verify (size + sha256) and commit gates pass
artifact_schema.current.json: root pointer, identical to commit.json, written atomically as the final publication step

decided.resume_inspection: read-only and fail closed: current.json -> complete; exactly one unpublished generation with verified plan + checkpoint + artifacts -> resumable at the verified prefix length; zero generations -> fresh; every inconsistency (missing/corrupt artifact, hash mismatch, non-contiguous list, context mismatch, ambiguous generations) -> corrupt
decided.unpublished_generation_ownership: the writer removes only its own generation and only when no publication was attempted

verification.determinism_proof: crash-resumed run produces the identical checkpoint_hash and memcmp-identical band artifacts as the uninterrupted reference run
verification.suite: 571 test cases, 2854010+ assertions green including all prior v2 gates

delegations.gate_9: multiband halo/ring state is not part of the checkpoint contract yet; a band commit today covers the plan's working columns without halo rows
delegations.gate_10: production wiring: the phase driver must call inspect before begin/adopt, supply the real predecessor hashes, and enforce the transaction order end to end; local warp fields extend local_warp_representation after gate 8
